scope: Windows process lifecycle and evidence publication; no new physical validity claim
old_implementation: Observed descendant polling returned COMPLETED before an unobserved DEVNULL grandchild wrote its final marker.
additional_runtime_finding: Assigning Microsoft Store venv launcher alone is insufficient: App Execution Alias broker starts interpreter outside inherited job.
implementation: Suspended exact interpreter launch, pre-resume job assignment/membership, kernel active count completion, owned job termination, kill-on-close, explicit handle inheritance, bounded log cleanup.
runtime_bridge: Byte-identical loaded CPython executable and stdlib DLL cache, source/complete inventory/configuration hashes checked; original venv packages and frozen app path; active venv unchanged.
limits: Windows only; unsupported platforms launch nothing.
Ordinary CreateProcess inheritance, not hostile external process broker containment.
Locally trusted cache; integrity checks are not security against hostile same-user filesystem control.
Memory limit uses sampled aggregate RSS, not a hard allocation quota.
Cleanup can continue beyond work deadline for bounded termination and log draining.
supersedes_supervision_description_only: route-check-execution/handoff.json; historical deferred publication results remain retained

nested_startup_amendment.trigger: EngineService worker calls frozen_environment, replacing PYTHONPATH before a nested native checker. Original bridge relied on inherited private DLL path and failed to import _socket.
nested_startup_amendment.fix: Hash-bound generated .pth prepends sys.prefix/DLLs at every site startup, before original packages, independent of inherited PYTHONPATH.
